name: build_collider
summary: Build the collision world every planning skill runs in: robot (+ mounted gripper) + static fixtures + obstacles.
pre: the object about to be PICKED is NOT included (it is grasped, not an obstacle)
post: a compiled collider, passed explicitly (collider=) to every planning call
doc: Build + compile a collision world for this arm and RETURN it -- the

name: moveto
summary: Free collision-planned travel (RRT) to a config or a tcp pose, carrying whatever is held.
pre: pose goals need a tcp (the working frame)
post: arm at the goal; held object carried collision-checked

failures.ik: zero candidates: the pose is out of reach -- change the pose or the base; all invalid: it is blocked -- change the world or the grasp
failures.start_invalid: the world is mis-set-up (start already colliding)
failures.goal_invalid: the explicit goal config collides -- pick another
failures.rrt: no path in budget -- retry with a larger budget or another goal IK branch

signature: moveto(self, goal, *, collider, tcp=None, constraints=(), start_qs=None, ee_qpos=None, max_iters=2000, time_limit=3.0, shortcut=True, diag=None)
doc: Free RRT move to ``goal`` -- a full joint config, or a tcp pose

name: linear
summary: Straight cartesian leg of the tcp (no RRT) -- the mating / insertion / press move.
pre: collider built; the line start is the current tcp pose of start_qs (or given explicitly)
post: tcp moved straight to the goal pose

failures.cartesian: ik broke: the line exits the workspace -- shorten it or reorient; blocked: an obstacle crosses the line -- clear it or approach from elsewhere

signature: insert(self, goal_pos, goal_rotmat, *, collider, tcp, start_qs, constraints=(), start_pos=None, start_rotmat=None, granularity=0.005, **kw)
doc: Straight CARTESIAN move (no RRT) of ``tcp`` to ``(goal_pos,

name: approach
summary: RRT to a pre-grasp then a straight descent along the approach axis -- how every pick and place reaches its target.
pre: collider built; grasp/goal pose chosen (e.g. from reason_grasps)
post: tcp at the grasp pose, having come in straight

failures.ik: pre-grasp unreachable or blocked -- try another grasp
failures.rrt: travel found no path -- larger budget or another grasp
failures.cartesian: descent broke or is blocked -- another approach direction or grasp

signature: approach(self, goal_pos, goal_rotmat, *, collider, tcp, constraints=(), start_qs=None, **kw)

name: depart
summary: Straight retreat along the approach axis (back out the way the hand came in), optionally RRT-parking after.
post: tcp retreated depart_distance; optionally parked at end_qs

failures.rrt: park leg found no path -- larger budget or another park

signature: depart(self, start_pos, start_rotmat, *, collider, tcp, start_qs, constraints=(), **kw)
doc: Retreat from a grasp along the approach axis (cartesian) in

name: hold
summary: Take the object into the end effector at the current config; subsequent motion carries it collision-checked.
pre: arm AT the grasp config (plan there first)
object resting at its grasp pose
post: object mounted on the gripper; collider refreshed
doc: Take ``obj`` into this arm's end effector: mount it at the EE's grasp,

name: release
summary: Drop the held object (open + unmount); subsequent motion is empty-handed.
pre: object currently held; arm at the place pose
post: object free at its current pose; collider refreshed
doc: Drop ``obj`` from the end effector and ``refresh`` ``collider`` back to

name: reachable
summary: Cheap feasibility gate: the nearest collision-free IK for a pose, WITHOUT motion planning -- vet every key pose of a plan before paying for any leg.
returns: a config, or None (diag counts split unreachable vs blocked)
signature: reachable(self, goal, *, collider, tcp, constraints=(), ref_qs=None, diag=None)

name: reason_grasps
summary: Which grasps are reachable + collision-free at ALL the given object poses -- THE coupling constraint of pick-then-place; an empty result is what calls for a regrasp.
returns: {gid: [config at each pose, ...]}; empty -> no single grasp works everywhere -- insert an intermediate placement (regrasp) or add grasps
signature: reason_grasps(self, grasps, obj_pose_list, *, collider, constraints=(), which='pre', **kw)

name: generate_grasps
summary: Generate object-local antipodal (2-point pinch) grasp candidates for a gripper on a mesh.
pre: gripper model; object SceneObject with mesh
returns: list of Grasp (object-local); empty -> loosen density / tolerances, or the object does not fit the jaw
signature: antipodal(gripper, target_sobj, density=0.02, normal_tol_deg=20, roll_step_deg=30, clearance=0.002, score_weights=(0.7, 0.3), exclude_regions=None, pre_open=0.5)

name: stable_placements
summary: The poses an object can REST in -- the intermediate placements a regrasp routes through.
pre: object mesh (+ optional center of mass)
returns: stable resting poses with support facets
doc: segs = list of list of face ids

name: pick_and_place
summary: home -> pick -> lift -> transfer -> place -> release -> retreat, choosing a grasp feasible at BOTH ends (reason_grasps inside). The one canonical composition; other shapes are written as Recipes, not added as skills.
pre: grasps generated; pick/place poses known; collider WITHOUT the object
post: object resting at the place pose; arm retreated
returns: MotionData, or None (no common grasp fully planned -- regrasp via stable_placements, or add grasps)
signature: pick_and_place(self, obj, grasps, pick_pose, place_pose, *, collider, **kw)
doc: Full home -> pick -> lift -> transfer -> place -> RELEASE -> retreat for
